scope: Read-only source/fixture/artifact review; no solver or test rerun by reviewer
limitations: Passing existing local convergence and initializer flags is not a global first-arrival or continuous time/source accuracy certificate.
An invalid line-search forward evaluation aborts with its failed candidate and last accepted state; it is not an adaptive backtracking or restart implementation.

Only failed-ray vertices are saved; an empty ray is explicit in status and contributes no vertex rows. Exceptions before a ray array exists retain state/context rather than inventing per-ray evaluations.
Returned derivative dimensions distinguish requested/unevaluated arrays; finite-ray checks remain separate from the metadata flag.
The tested paths use fresh output directories. This change does not implement cleanup or provenance reconciliation of unrelated pre-existing final files.
No real inversion was run in this review or component evidence.
